items: Draw a line and hold for a moment to snap it straight
Tools → Screenshot: grab any part of a PDF onto the board
Split view: resizing no longer jumps the PDF page, and a Clear button sits next to the page arrows
Current page number now shows on the Pages button
When finger drawing is off: two fingers pan/zoom the board, and a two-finger double-tap undoes
The hidden toolbar comes back in the centre
Clock is now turned on/off from the admin menu
Fixes: boards accept admin commands even with a wrong clock, and approved boards show up on every admin PC
